reviewer: Codex preliminary review; not a teacher or independent evaluator
topic: Phép cộng nhẩm trong phạm vi 10
rubric: Check output schema, arithmetic answers, requested number scope, elementary readability, and whether the RAG output aligns with the retrieved outcome. Human scoring remains required.

results.sourceGrounding: The system prompt contained 3 cited curriculum chunks; the generated four addition questions fit the Math G1 outcome for mental addition/subtraction within 10. No citations were embedded in the student-facing quiz fields.
No official curriculum text or citation was supplied to the model. The output happened to match the requested elementary arithmetic scope.

latencyMillis.note: These values measure the chat call only. The separate retrieval probe took 1124 ms and is not included.

observations: Both outputs were schema-valid and all eight arithmetic answers were correct.
No answer-correctness lift was observed in this single pair.
The RAG output included optional visualPrompt/audioText fields for all four questions; the baseline did not. One sample cannot attribute that difference to RAG.

The pair was generated with minScore 0.75. The same topic returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE at the configured threshold 0.855 in the adjacent probe, so this is exploratory and would not pass the current fail-closed production gate.
